newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 183-day t-bill average yield 6.245 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 183-day t-bill average yield 6.245 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.245 percent at its auction of 183-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit.
At its previous auction for 182-day treasury bills of a similar amount on January 9, the central bank had accepted bids at an average yield of 6.266 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.258/225 percent against 6.274/245 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 91-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit and 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on February 13.
The next auction of 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit will be held on February 12.
